scenes.heading: Exporting Models as JSON
scenes.narration: Components. Exporting Models as JSON. In this video we review 7 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: How do you annotate a Sling Model so it can be exported as JSON?
scenes.heading: Add @Exporter(name = "jackson", extensions = "json")
scenes.body: The speech says Sling Models can be exported as JSON with the Sling Model Exporter by annotating the model with @Exporter(name = "jackson", extensions = "json").

scenes.question: What request pattern returns the serialized Sling Model JSON for a resource?
scenes.heading: Request the resource with the .model.json selector and extension
scenes.body: The speech says requesting the resource with the .model.json selector and extension returns the serialized model, such as /content/wknd/page/jcr:content/root/title.model.json.

scenes.question: Why do Core Components implement ComponentExporter and ContainerExporter?
scenes.heading: So components can be exported as part of the page JSON, which underpins SPA Editor and headless consumption

scenes.question: How do you exclude or rename properties in exported model JSON?
scenes.heading: Use @JsonIgnore to exclude properties and @JsonProperty to rename them
scenes.body: The speech says the exporter uses Jackson and specifically calls out @JsonIgnore for excluding properties and @JsonProperty for renaming them.

scenes.question: Given a scenario where a model is exported as part of the page model, what else does the speech say the model needs besides the exporter annotation?
scenes.heading: It needs the resourceType parameter and a ComponentExporter implementation
scenes.body: The speech says to remember that the model needs the resourceType parameter and the ComponentExporter implementation when it is exported with the page model.

scenes.question: When should you add an exporter to a Sling Model?
scenes.heading: Only when the data is consumed as JSON
scenes.body: The speech clearly says a model that is only for HTL needs no exporter, and that you add the exporter only when the data is consumed as JSON.
